name: Prime Soul
description: (Tag:meta-resistance+)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:spirit+)(Tag:spirit-resistance+)(Tag:survival)Your soul has ascended to a Prime Soul, grown so powerful it needs no body to exist. Your soul affinity is massively enhanced, and you massively resist all soul, mind, and existence-targeting abilities. If you die, you shed your Husk and continue existing in Prime Soul form.
